## What's changed

- Added authenticated HLS playback for prepared Discovery media used by the native Apple TV player.
- Delivers Discovery streams as finite, byte-range-capable HLS segments so AVPlayer can start them reliably.
- Preserves the server's existing direct, remux, audio-only, video-only, and full-transcode decisions inside the HLS session.
- Keeps internal HLS source reads out of the viewer-facing Active Streams list and leaves Steam and retro playback paths unchanged.
